name: Algebra 1 Curated Source Enrichment Profile
principle: The Framework supplies positive models for natural wording, useful question families, visuals/tables, scaffolding, and misconceptions—not a passive citation warehouse. Purposeful procedural Practice repetition is allowed.
ordinary_build_rule: Use the curated section packet first. Full raw source books are intentionally not packaged. The compact source_documents index is fallback only.
source_use: Inspect section-specific question structures before authoring.
Use Math Note/table/figure ideas to plan representations and downstream Notes.
Consult curated excerpts for natural course wording and task architecture.
Use source-reference figure crops as visual models; adapt/recreate rather than automatically copying source artwork.
Use approved Bank-example figures directly only when they still fit and reveal no answer.
qa: A Framework-built Bank must be natural, visually rich, structurally secure, and instructionally sufficient. Purposeful repeated Practice families are not a quality regression.
Do not claim source grounding merely because source_basis names a section.

Audit repeated GENERIC PSEUDOCONTEXT stems/nouns such as quantity/units/plan/space when direct mathematics or a real context would be better. Do not audit repeated direct procedural Practice skeletons.

Representation-heavy sections require actual graphs/tables/diagrams where useful. For Algebra Bank builds, follow profiles/bank_course_profile.json representation map/floors; this is not an equal-percentage quota.
If every section chooses minimum destination counts, re-evaluate against source richness before PASS.
